title: Sequence release communications and privacy-safe summaries
creator: Amira Patel
description: Goal: Produce three coordinated artifacts for the 1.24 release that are privacy-safe, tiered by audience, and traceable for audit and redaction. Scope: executive one-pager, public-facing changelog (abridged), partner/enterprise changelog (detailed with opt-in callback instructions), and an internal runbook with rollback playbook and data-redaction checklist. Key constraints: legal review window (5 business days), embargo periods for specific security fixes, and automated redaction guidance for customer-identifiable examples. Acceptance criteria: 1) Executive brief approved by GTM and Product; 2) Public changelog vetted by Legal and Security and ready for scheduled publish; 3) Partner/Enterprise changelog includes migration notes and per-tenant considerations; 4) Internal runbook tested in tabletop and has assigned owners for rollback and Postmortem-when-required.
timeline: 2026-01-16: partner changelog draft and migration steps
2026-01-22: final approvals and scheduling for 2026-01-26 release window
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sensitive example data may be included in early drafts - Mitigation: automated redaction rules and manual Legal spot-checks.
Risk: Embargoed security fix leaks - Mitigation: restrict authoring access to project group + watermark drafts.
Risk: Timing mismatch between Docs and Console deploy - Mitigation: 'publish-notify' checklist and gating in the release playbook.
notes_and_decisions: 2026-01-11: Decided to produce tiered changelogs (public / partner / enterprise) to reduce customer confusion.
2026-01-13: Agreed on redaction-first authoring: authors must flag any customer examples, Legal will mark PHI/PII for removal.
2026-01-15: Security required an additional embargo flag in the header for any CVE-class fixes; implementation accepted.
2026-01-16: Docs recommended a short 'what to expect' migration section for enterprise customers and an opt-in deep-dive for partners.
2026-01-17: GTM asked for a 1-page executive 'impact + ask' to send to sales leadership ahead of publish.
Decision: Move the public changelog publish to 2026-01-26 10:00 PT contingent on Legal signoff on 2026-01-22.
